landing.hero_title: Aura Catch – Stop wasting time looking for promotions
landing.desc_p1: How many hours do you waste manually searching stores to find the perfect gift or home appliance within your budget?
landing.desc_bold1: With Aura Catch this is no longer a problem.
landing.desc_p2: You set the price and ours
landing.desc_bold3: You save time, we hunt for price drops.
landing.social_proof_title: We track prices from global chains and stores
landing.markets_title: We serve 31 markets around the world:
landing.f_ai_desc: Product search and recognition supported by intelligent AI models.
landing.f_global_desc: Monitoring offers and prices on 31 markets so that you always see the full picture.
landing.f_alerts_desc: Instant notifications about price drops and new deals.
landing.f_omnibus_desc: We verify fake promotions by showing the lowest price from the last 6 months.
landing.f_filters_desc: Follow only what interests you: New, Used or Outlet equipment.
landing.f_customs_desc: The app tracks the pure price of the product itself. Remember that the system does not take into account or show hidden shipping costs or possible customs duties for global purchases.
landing.t_style_desc: Subtle and elegant aesthetics in shades of rose gold.
landing.t_hunter_desc: Tactical, dark interface with neon accents for bargain hunters.
landing.t_original_desc: Classic, universal design in shades of deep navy blue.
landing.faq_q1: Does the application include delivery costs?
landing.faq_a1: No, our radar only focuses on the product's hard base price, ignoring variable shipping costs.
landing.faq_q2: What if the product is sold out?
landing.faq_a2: The system verifies availability (In-Stock). If the product is out of stock, we ignore the price and do not send false alarms.
landing.faq_q3: Is the application free to use?
landing.faq_a3: Yes! The FREE plan allows you to track 3 products for free in a 30-day cycle.
landing.pricing_subtitle: Get started for free. Go PRO whenever you want.

landing.tos_ownership: The owner of the Aura Catch website and application is Dariusz Szweda.
landing.tos_s3_2: 3.2. In the FREE plan, the price is updated once a day (every 24 hours), around the time when the product was added to the database.
landing.pp_s8_2: Account data is stored until the user uses the "Delete account and data" function.
landing.tos_s3_1: 3.1. A FREE plan user can track the product for 30 days from the time it is added.
landing.tos_s3_3: 3.3. After 30 days, tracking ends and historical product data is archived in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
